theme: The attention test: five under-$20 gestures that prove you know her
referenceStyle: Seven 3:4 phone photos, bold centered white text with a thick black outline, casual step-by-step humor, playful payoff

selected.reason: Flowers plus exact favorite snacks instantly communicates inexpensive personalization.
A box assembled from photos and favorite items proves the gift was built around one person.
The handmade Barcelona photo reel is a literal shared memory made tangible.
Premium versions of small everyday comforts support the small-luxury idea.
Every paper flower carries a specific message or memory, so the note cannot feel generic.
Color-matched, highly personal wrapping clearly signals intention before the gift is opened.
The relationship memory board is the strongest visual payoff for feeling known.

rejected.reason: Low resolution and reads as generic gift wrap rather than a relationship-specific gesture.
Useful concept, but the server returned HEIC content with a JPEG extension and the composition overlaps the favorites-basket slide.
